text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review original research article focused on the impacts of climate change on carbon storage in Swiss forests using a dynamic vegetation model. There is no evidence of spatially explicit national-scale LULC future prediction or mapping; rather, the study models carbon pools and species composition shifts under climate scenarios. The study does not meet core inclusion criteria related to LULC prediction, scenario-based spatial LULC mapping, or quantitative accuracy assessment of LULC projections.)
